entry.title: Search
entry.summary: Listing pages are in the site search, and a child's own page still ranks first for its title.
entry.content:
Listing pages are indexed like any other page, so a search finds them. The page numbers in the pagination are not indexed.

A child’s title is the heading of its own page, so a search for that title leads to the child first, not to the listing page that lists it.
